summary: The messaging fault eval's readiness waits treat a timed-out CLI probe as an incomplete sample, so only the outer readiness deadline ends the wait.

replay.detail: Only the messaging fault eval fixture changes. No runtime replay behavior changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, schema versions or migration code change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or fleet coordination behavior change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol, provider or harness contract changes. Non-timeout probe errors still fail immediately and the ten-second delivery gate is unchanged. Each wait writes a messaging_faults.wait JSON event to stderr.

downtime.detail: A test-only change adds no service interruption.

manual.detail: No installation steps or starting-state transitions are required.

recovery.detail: No runtime recovery or database swap-back behavior changes.
